title: AWS credentials file served
description: The response is an AWS shared-credentials file: the `[default]` or `[profile ...]` section header together with an aws_access_key_id key is the format the AWS CLI and SDKs read. The file pairs the access key id with its secret.
remediation: Remove the file from the web root, deactivate the exposed access keys, and issue replacements that are delivered through an instance role or a secret manager rather than a file.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the credentials-file shape; it does not use the key and cannot determine the permissions attached to it.
